evidence: blind PRIORS=none run 2026-11-26 (skill 61a2316, stripped copy with step8-fix.md's worked example scrubbed): artifacts/2026-11-26-dit-fp8-blind -- 5b 100/100 deterministic on 3 nodes, root cause in 1 iteration, T1/T2/B1 reproducer 200/200 -> 0/200, model 4/4 -> 0/3
the example's own investigation: validation/answers/dit_fp8_train_nan/README.md, MI350X jobs 145661 145736 145756

root_cause.mechanism: TunableOp ROCm FP8 dispatch instantiates ScaledGemmTunableOp<mat1 dtype, mat2 dtype> but passes mat2 as hipBLASLt matrix A: with mixed e4m3/e5m2 operands every hipBLASLt candidate decodes each operand in the other FP8 format (a_type bf8_r / b_type f8_r vs the default call's f8_r / bf8_r) -> Inf/NaN
conditions: mixed FP8 formats (torchao float8 training: e5m2 gradients x e4m3 inputs/weights in the weight-gradient GEMM)
TunableOp picks a hipBLASLt candidate over Default (run to run)

notes: Every TunableOp hipBLASLt candidate for a mixed e5m2 x e4m3fn _scaled_mm is wrong (420/420 on MI350X); the Default entry is correct. Which GEMM shape and solution TunableOp picks varies per trainer, so bug.geometry, bug.kernel and root_cause.location.kernel are open (null). The real fix (R1, dispatch on the hipBLASLt operand order, args.mata/args.matb) is untested: it needs a torch build. A run that blames a hipBLASLt solution (e.g. Gemm_Hipblaslt_320617) or an extreme FP8 scale as the root cause has followed ROCm/rocm-libraries#9450's text, not the evidence: it compares DIFFERENT on root_cause.component.
